svg.title: Meiosis followed by mitosis in an ascus
svg.desc: Seven successive stages: one nucleus, one meiotic spindle, two nuclei, two meiotic spindles, four nuclei, four mitotic spindles, and eight ordered spores. Six arrows give temporal order. A bracket identifies only the bottom adjacent pair as genetically identical cells. Chromatin is schematic and unmeasured; colors do not denote alleles.
